ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, which labeled part is responsible for visual memory?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a side view of the brain with labeled regions. Label G has a leader line pointing to the blue region at the very back/posterior end of the cerebrum, located above the cerebellum. Reasoning: The posterior brain region is the occipital/visual area, which is responsible for vision-related processing including visual memory. Therefore, the labeled part responsible for visual memory is G.
